headline: Revenue Operating System.

hero.title: Revenueable.ai
hero.outcome: Built a real-time visitor identification and intent scoring engine.

context.paragraph: B2B marketing teams were flying blind. 98% of traffic remained anonymous, and CRM data was disconnected from web behavior.

problem.core: The core problem wasn't 'analytics'—it was action. Marketing tools showed charts but didn't trigger revenue actions in real-time.

build.name: Identity Resolution Graph
build.description: Serverless edge functions matching IP/Device fingerprints to corporate domains.

build.name: Intent Scoring Model
build.description: Real-time vector scoring of user behavior against ideal customer profiles.

build.name: Signal Distribution Bus
build.description: Event-driven architecture routing signals to Slack, CRM, and ad platforms instantly.

flow.logic: Visitor lands → Edge function executes fingerprinting.
High-intent signal triggers webhook to Sales Ops.

learnings: Speed is a feature in data products.
Enrichment data decays fast; requires constant cleaning.
Sales teams need 'less' data, but 'better' timing.

headline: Offline-first community platform with 200+ paying members.

hero.title: NexoCircle
hero.outcome: Shipped an offline-first membership operating system.

context.paragraph: Digital loneliness is peaking. Existing platforms (Meetup, Facebook Groups) optimize for online engagement, not offline trust.
constraints: High trust requirement for offline safety

problem.core: Online-first platforms fail to transition users to offline interactions because they lack the 'social scaffold' needed to break the ice.

build.name: Member Directory
build.description: Privacy-aware searchable graph of member interests.

flow.logic: User applies → Vetted by community manager.
Accepted user gains access to 'New Member' events only.
Attending offline event unlocks digital directory.
Hosting an event unlocks 'Core Member' status.

learnings: Offline trust must be earned digitally first.
Gamification works best when it unlocks status, not badges.

headline: Scale infrastructure for 24/7 autonomous voice agents.

hero.title: Telecallers.ai
hero.outcome: Built the telephony and orchestration layer for AI voice agents.

context.paragraph: Outbound sales teams burn out on low-connect rates. Humans shouldn't be dialing numbers; they should be closing deals.

problem.core: LLMs are slow. Telephony is fast. The gap between them creates awkward 'robot pauses' that kill conversion.

build.name: Voice Stream Orchestrator
build.description: Websocket manager handling audio buffers between Twilio and OpenAI.

build.name: Interrupt Handler
build.description: Logic layer that stops audio generation instantly when user speaks.

build.name: Campaign Manager
build.description: UI for uploading leads and scheduling dial windows.

flow.logic: User interrupts → Audio clears → Agent listens.

learnings: Latency is the #1 UX killer in voice.
Voice agents need 'personality' prompts to sound natural.
Handling voicemail detection is critical for cost.

headline: Programmatic SEO engine driving 500k+ organic impressions.

hero.title: EstateKart.ai
hero.outcome: Deployed a programmatic SEO architecture for real estate discovery.

context.paragraph: NRIs (Non-Resident Indians) looking to buy property face fragmented information. Aggregators are spammy; developers are opaque.

problem.core: Generic listing pages don't capture long-tail intent. Users search for specific investment thesis (e.g. 'Rental yield in Whitefield'), not just '3BHK'.

build.name: Data Normalization Pipeline
build.description: Cleaning unstructured developer data into a structured schema.

build.name: Page Generator Engine
build.description: Next.js ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration) for thousands of pages.

build.name: Market Intelligence Blocks
build.description: Automated charts and yield calculations per micro-market.

flow.logic: Lead qualified and passed to partner.

learnings: Programmatic SEO needs unique data, not just AI text.
Structure > Volume. 1,000 good pages beat 100,000 spam pages.
Internal linking architecture dictates indexing speed.
